question.prompt: In parallelogram \(ABCD\), \(\angle A=70^\circ\). Find \(\angle B\). Also, \(AB=3\). Find \(CD\). (Answer in order, separated by a comma, without units.)

solutions.explanation: Adjacent angles of a parallelogram are supplementary, so \(\angle B=180^\circ-70^\circ=110^\circ\). Opposite sides are equal, so \(CD=AB=3\).
solutions.title: Adjacent angles and opposite sides
